tha-ap482:1.1: Pulinacaṅkamiya.] Migaluddo pure āsiṃ araññe kānane ahaṃ / vātamigaṃ gavesanto caṅkamaṃ addasaṃ ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap482:2.1: Ucchaṅgapulinaṃ gayha caṅkame okiriṃ ahaṃ / pasannacitto sumano sugatassa sirīmato. // //
tha-ap482:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe pulinaṃ okiriṃ ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi puḷinassa idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap482:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pulinacaṅkamiyo th. i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap482:11.1: Naḷamālī Maṇidado Ukkāsatika Vījanī Kummāso ca Kusaṭṭho ca Giripunnāgiyo pi ca
tha-ap482:12.1: Valliṅkaro Pānadhido atha Pulinacaṅkamo gāthāyo pañcanavuti gaṇitāyo vibhāvihi.
